notes: Variant treated as a strict pronated bodyweight pull-up from a fixed overhead bar, not a chin-up, neutral-grip pull-up, towel pull-up, suspension pull-up, assisted pull-up, kipping pull-up, or weighted pull-up. Visible roles are intentionally conservative and use only local anatomy labels that already resolve to mesh files. Direct evidence also discusses brachioradialis and likely elbow-flexor contributions from brachialis during pull-up variations, but the current local anatomy map does not expose brachioradialis or brachialis; they were not added as visible roles. Teres major was also excluded because the reviewed exact pull-up EMG sources did not isolate it, even though vertical-pull anatomy suggests an assisting role. EMG findings are acute excitation estimates and should not be read as direct hypertrophy, mechanical tension, adaptation, or injury-risk proof.
